title: An article that repeats itself excessively for testing
summary: A long-enough summary at least forty characters wide for schema reasons, used by tests.
content:
## Intro

Artificial general intelligence describes a hypothetical AI system that can learn or perform any intellectual task that a human being can. The term has been used inconsistently for decades, which is part of why current debates feel so confusing.
